desc: 鲜果氛围开场、成分环形图谱、规格与机制说明、软糖质感微距与CTA收口的软糖营养品套图
name: 果味复合维生素软糖款

shots.intent: 首屏以鲜果环绕与暖白氛围建立天然好感，承担详情页开屏承接与点击转化。
shots.textZone: top-left script headline in leaf green #A8C948 plus one short subtitle line in #2D2D2D

shots.intent: 用一张规格卡交代名称、规格、适用人群与用法，一次性消除基础疑问。
shots.textZone: orange pill section header #F08A3C top center; four short spec labels with thin #EAD9C4 divider lines in #2D2D2D

shots.intent: 以瓶身居中的环形成分图谱直观呈现营养构成，建立配方专业感。
shots.textZone: orange pill section header #F08A3C above the ring reading 「主要成分」; four to six rotated nutrient labels placed evenly around the ring in #2D2D2D

shots.intent: 以说明卡承载营养科普短句，用克制的专家语气传递可信感而非功效承诺。
shots.textZone: orange pill section header #F08A3C reading 「营养说明」; three to four short statement lines in #2D2D2D, each preceded by a check-dot icon

shots.intent: 微距呈现软糖剂型的糖霜质感，为口感与剂型提供直观证据，激发尝新欲。
shots.textZone: small annotation label lower right, one 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at 12pt

shots.intent: 鲜果平铺横幅营造每日享用场景，让买家把产品代入自己的日常节奏。
shots.textZone: two centered headline lines inside the cream panel in #2D2D2D

shots.intent: 低角度产品展示叠加行动按钮，在详情页末端完成最后一次行动召唤。
shots.textZone: one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D above the product; rounded CTA button in citrus orange #F08A3C with white text 「{callout_1}」 max 8 characters

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF and warm cream #FDF4E6 rounded panels with fresh fruit accents; a light grey #ECECEC newsprint texture panel on the hero's right third
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons with circular fruit photo medallions and leaf green #A8C948 check-dots; orange pill section headers
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key soft studio light, front-left key with soft fill, gentle soft contact shadows; flat-lays use diffused daylight 5500K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh fruit-flavored supplement ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm cream #FDF4E6, charcoal text #2D2D2D, citrus orange accent #F08A3C, and soft leaf green #A8C948 for icon dots; warm bright tone; modern rounded sans-serif with short 「」-wrapped headlines only; clean white and warm cream backgrounds with fresh fruit accents; bright high-key soft studio lighting with gentle shadows and soft contact shadows; rounded-corner info cards with orange pill section headers and circular fruit photo medallions; consistent thin-line icons with circular photo chips; stable centered product presentation; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable centered upright product; slight 3/4 hero angle for openings; consistent product scale across infographic insets
style.surfaceSystem: round white ceramic plate, white marble-look counter, matte white and cream card surfaces
style.typography: modern rounded sans-serif; short 「」-wrapped headlines only; no dense body text
